tags.name: Tickets
tags.description: To discuss any issue you have, you can create tickets to technical support. You can work with created tickets: list, get, update, close, reopen, or rate a particular ticket.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: To give you a feedback on a ticket, technical support adds comments. You can also add your comments to discuss the ticket. Besides, you can get or list comments and rate the comments added by technical support.

tags.name: Topics
tags.description: You specify a ticket topic when creating a ticket. You cannot edit a ticket topic after creating a ticket.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Supporting entity to help create tickets with specific category.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Supporting entity to help create tickets with specific product.
